subject: Follow-up: Redwood demo & procurement next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Hall <jessica.hall@acme.com>, Kate Olson <kate.olson@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Redwood demo & procurement next steps

Hi Jessica / Kate —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our call: 

- What we covered: product demo (hosted API, Dedicated, Private), observability/console, and security/compliance baseline.
- Procurement ask: Acme is evaluating options for a POC followed by enterprise procurement. You indicated teams will decide between card vs PO for the POC and likely PO for the enterprise contract.
- Security gating: Acme requires SOC 2 Type II evidence, a signed DPA, and completion of the security questionnaire before procurement/legal sign-off.

Agreed next steps: 
1) Marissa (me) to share SOC 2 report and the standard DPA + a formal quote for review — by EOD 5/22.
2) Jessica to confirm whether the POC will be on card or via PO (procurement path) and share any internal PO template or procurement portal info.
3) Acme security to indicate if the completed questionnaire is required up front or can be provisioned during the POC.

Attachments I will send: SOC 2 report (redacted where appropriate), draft DPA, and a POC quote.

If helpful, we can also list marketplace options (AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace) — we can provide an invoice/ordering guide if you prefer marketplace procurement.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (pdf), DPA_Redwood_v3.pdf (pdf), quote-Redwood-ACME-0426.pdf (pdf)

From: Jessica Hall <jessica.hall@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Olson <kate.olson@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood demo & procurement next steps

Thanks Marissa — good demo. A couple quick notes from procurement/legal/security: 

- For the POC, the team will likely start on a corporate card to move faster; enterprise procurement (PO) will be required before volume rollout.
- We need SOC 2 Type II evidence and the DPA for legal review. Please send the SOC 2 report and your standard DPA. If there are any carve-outs in the SOC report, call those out.
- Our security team will have a questionnaire. If you can provide a SOC report and the DPA, security can decide whether they require the full questionnaire completed prior to POC or if it can follow during the POC.

Procurement request: Please include a formal quote with your billing contact and invoice remit-to details. If you support AWS Marketplace, that'd be preferable for our procurement team — please indicate marketplace availability on the quote.

We expect to start the POC next week (week of 5/25) if we have a card option and basic security docs; PO for enterprise procurement will take ~3-4 weeks once legal signs off.

Thanks,
Jessica Hall
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
procurement@acme.com

Thanks Rishi / Marissa — received the docs. Quick confirmations: 

- We have the SOC2 report and the DPA; security will review the SOC report and let us know if the questionnaire is required prior to POC.
- For the POC we will proceed on corporate card to start next week. Please send an invoice/charge instructions for the POC to procurement@acme.com. For enterprise procurement (PO), our procurement team will open a PR and route the PO to the billing contact on your quote.
- Marketplace: yes, Acme prefers AWS Marketplace where possible. Can you confirm Redwood is available on AWS Marketplace (or provide an alternative ordering guide)? If not live, we can use direct PO for enterprise.

Next steps for Redwood: send final quote/invoice remit details and confirm marketplace availability. Security will follow up if they need the questionnaire completed upfront.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to starting the POC.

Jessica
